issues.title: Ingest Cross County’s 2026 budget
issues.detail: The county’s 2026 budget as filed with the state (artransparency.gov, May 2026), turned into a money trail with a page cite on every amount.

stamped.revealed: $14,453,810 across 19 funds. The largest: General Fund ($6,514,147), Hospital Sales Tax Fund ($3,295,650), Road Fund ($3,140,400). Every total marked complete adds to its parts to the cent; where the county’s own pages disagree, the page keeps the printed number and an open question below.
